source: Proposed first-party objekts audit methodology; not a validated research corpus, observed organizational chart or evidence of studio capability.
purpose: Evidence-led diagnosis and bounded professional production scope. Full original screenplay generation is a later separately scoped SKRIPT function.
rules: Initial state is NOT_ASSESSED. An unprovided item is not an absent function or an observed defect.
Each diagnostic is a conditional mechanism, not a finding to assign universally. Cite an inspected version/locator and consider its strongest counter-reading before applying it.
CONFIRMED_ABSENT needs a complete relevant artifact or explicit confirmation; complete script inspection cannot establish external licence absence.
No mandatory crew, plot, conflict, brand causality, lens, shot count, full bible, price or studio purchase.
A proposed artifact/test is not completed work; structural/media checks are not human directing-quality acceptance.
Objekts scope/capacity and specialist availability require actual human confirmation; no presumed physical filming, legal clearance or research service.
Use applicable functions at the requested scale. A whole-script audit must not collapse into one micro-fix.
Preserve source meaning and authorial invariants; judge ambiguity, musical structure and expressive recurrence contextually.

departments.central_question: What business or artistic outcome makes this project worth making?
departments.evidence_boundary: No business KPI in fiction is not a defect. Absence of a strategy document does not establish absence of intention.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: The supplied brief requires a readable product demonstration, but the inspected concept hides the product action behind unrelated spectacle; or named approvers demand incompatible outcomes for the same master.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: The team may polish a different promise; a later concept rejection can invalidate assets, shots and versions.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Choose a governing purpose with the decision owner, or separate genuinely different deliverable objectives. Keep spectacle that serves that choice; explicitly allow a non-selling brand-film route.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Purpose-to-evidence map: intent, actual/planned screen event, conflicting approval, affected deliverable and decision owner.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: An actual owner records the governing priority per deliverable; each required promise has a planned/readable event or a named unresolved test. This is alignment, not proof of commercial effect.

departments.upstream_dependencies: Author/commissioner purpose;20 evidence for factual claims;22 actual approval owner
departments.roles_needed: Author or commissioning decision owner; strategist only where positioning is genuinely unresolved.
departments.scope_unit: One map per distinct brief/deliverable family. Reuse an existing coherent brief; no mandatory sales funnel or invented KPI.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Translate an approved purpose into creative/digital production work; avoid selling execution before the central contradiction is resolved.
departments.preserve: Preserve coherent artistic purpose and already approved requirements. No compulsory conversion objective.

departments.central_question: Whose situation and knowledge must this film address?
departments.evidence_boundary: Report viewer readings as hypotheses unless a real study exists. Unknown audience is an open evidence boundary, not evidence of no audience.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: A supplied rationale calls an unrelated anecdote or demographic label a universal audience insight; or an inspected sequence requires reference knowledge excluded by the stated viewing context.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: The idea may rely on knowledge or a tension the intended viewers do not share; invented certainty conceals the creative bet.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Separate observation, hypothesis and competing reading. Decide whether to add a minimal contextual cue, keep deliberate exclusion, or run a neutral decision-specific test.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Evidence/hypothesis table and inference map: what is on screen, what must be known, one competing reading and the exact uncertainty to test.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Assertions trace to relevant evidence; a real proposed test specifies its question/context and records actual responses only after running. A reasoned reading is not measured comprehension.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 01 purpose when relevant;04/05 inspected material and author intention;underlying cultural/source context
departments.roles_needed: Author/research owner; researcher or cultural specialist only for a consequential unresolved claim.
departments.scope_unit: One decision-relevant uncertainty/test, not a general research programme by default.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Build the visual prototype/animatic that isolates the inference; recruiting research participants and collecting results require separately confirmed capability.
departments.preserve: Preserve niche audiences, productive ambiguity and sound actual findings; do not manufacture mainstream mandates.

departments.central_question: What visual proposition makes this work memorable, distinct and appropriate?
departments.evidence_boundary: Brand-removal is a lens for an attributable ad, not a universal artistic test. Familiar symbols can be effective when their actual treatment earns them.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: Replacing the named product leaves every event equally suitable for competitors despite a brief requiring attribution; or several supplied routes differ only in decoration while the expressive observation remains generic.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: Expensive execution can remain interchangeable; a style choice may conceal an unresolved idea.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Find the specific observation or verified product/source property that governs the mechanism. Compare materially different expressive routes, or consciously retain a less attributable brand film.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Concept comparison: current generic move, chosen mechanism, unchanged authorial/source invariants, two decision-useful alternatives and their expressive/production costs.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: The route has a defensible source/product relation and a distinct screen mechanism in a rough demonstration. Author selection is recorded; no recall or originality statistic is invented.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 01/02 only when governing;04/05 expression;20 product/source truth
departments.roles_needed: Creative lead or author; copy/strategy specialist only for a real message/attribution problem.
departments.scope_unit: One argued concept plus useful alternatives, not a compulsory campaign volume.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Concept-to-visual treatment, styleframes or a scoped proof of the central mechanism after capability/scope confirmation.
departments.preserve: Preserve distinctive existing choices and poetic/noncommercial forms; no imposed CTA or magical product causality.

departments.central_question: What unfolds through actions, changes and audience inferences?
departments.evidence_boundary: An excerpt cannot prove whole-work absence. Chronology gaps, unresolved endings, non-plot structures and repetition are not automatically defects; recover adaptation/source context first.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: In a complete inspected script, a decisive action needs knowledge/setup no scene supplies and no coherent ellipsis accounts for; or repeated scenes/symbols add neither a changed relation nor a supported musical/formal function.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: The intended turn can feel arbitrary or the work flatten; extra coverage/effects cannot by themselves solve the structural cause.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Map the intended inference and best competing reading. Restore minimal setup, alter a consequence, or preserve an earned ellipsis. Cut/reorder/transform only recurrence that fails the governing form.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Whole-work verdict with scene/beat dependency and recurrence map, prioritized problems and one bounded illustrative repair. No unsolicited replacement screenplay.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: A fresh reading can trace the chosen inference through actual revised scenes; the author judges whether the intended experience survives. Checklist compliance is not good writing or real G3 evidence.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 01/03 if governing;02/18 exact underlying source for adaptation/music;05 chosen form
departments.roles_needed: Author and script/editorial reader; sustained script development needs separately scoped human script-editing work.
departments.scope_unit: One whole-work diagnosis plus consequential sequence/scene notes; separately scope full original screenplay work under later SKRIPT.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Development audit, treatment and production implications after the structural decision. Do not imply effects rescue writing or silently generate a complete new screenplay.
departments.preserve: Preserve theme, faith, relationships, complexity and successful scenes; no compulsory three acts, protagonist or conflict.

departments.central_question: Why are events shown this way and through whose knowledge?
departments.evidence_boundary: Distinguish script inference, planned staging and an observed cut. A text cannot prove the quality of an unseen performance or frame.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: Inspected coverage withholds the only visible cause of a crucial reaction while later shots require it; or uniform emphasis obscures a shift the stated scene depends on.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: The intended alignment/revelation may not reach the viewer; more technical coverage may still omit the decisive information.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Choose who owns the revelation, then alter the exact spatial relation, camera attention, duration or offscreen event that carries it. Keep withholding/fixed distance when purposeful.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Viewer-knowledge/scene-intention map and affected shot functions with a bounded staging diagram; state what existing material already suffices.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: A board/rough-cut review can identify what becomes available when; actual response remains unmeasured until real viewing. Author evaluates the chosen emphasis.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 04 scene function;06/08 action and space;18 sound/source structure
departments.roles_needed: Director/author; experienced live-action coordination only where a real set requires it.
departments.scope_unit: One staging solution per affected scene/shot family plus reusable grammar, not an automatic whole-film reshoot.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Directorial audit, treatment, previs and scoped digital execution; physical filming requires separately confirmed external scope.
departments.preserve: Preserve restraint, mood, offscreen space, silence and successful formal choices; no mandatory explanatory close-up.

departments.central_question: What playable action occurs, where, and with which eyelines?
departments.evidence_boundary: A still cannot prove gesture timing/acting; separate human acting, animated pose/timing and generated motion. Limited animation or awkward texture can be intentional.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: In viewed motion, contact/object transfer or eyeline conflicts with the intended action; or a supplied performance instruction names only emotion and provides no playable task, relation or purposeful non-action.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: The beat can become unconvincing or shift meaning; comp cannot reliably invent all missing interaction information later.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Restage/reanimate the exact action phase or redesign the cut; translate emotion into a playable action/avoidance and test timing without prescribing generic intensity.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Action-phase/eyeline or pose/timing note with actual interval, contact anchors and a focused rehearsal/animation test.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Real rehearsal/animatic/motion playback supports the chosen interaction through the event and adjacent cut; a written note alone does not pass performance.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 04/05 intention;07 identity;08 geometry;13/14 motion route
departments.roles_needed: Director or animation/performance lead; actual actor/animator as needed. Qualified stunt/intimacy/child/animal supervision only when the scene requires it.
departments.scope_unit: A specific action/performance problem per scene and required motion phases, not emotion prompt counts.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Performance previs, motion audit and scoped digital repair. Casting, live performance and specialist safety are separate confirmed functions.
departments.preserve: Preserve character-specific behavior, nonprofessional texture and stillness; do not replace them with polished generic emotion.

departments.central_question: Which person or identity must persist through scenes?
departments.evidence_boundary: Do not identify a person or infer consent from appearance. Intentional age/state/performer changes are not identity drift; no uploaded release does not mean no permission exists.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: Linked inspected shots required to show the same unchanged person have materially conflicting identity features; or documented permission excludes the contemplated identifiable likeness/voice use.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: Recognition/relationship can break, or the route may exceed evidenced authorization and require broad replacement.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Choose the authoritative identity/state rule and repair affected features while retaining expression. Route the precise use to its owner or choose a non-identifying alternative.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Identity/state continuity sheet with authority, allowed variation, representative angles/motion and known permission/use limits.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Actual representative multi-angle/motion checks follow the approved rule; necessary permission or chosen alternative is evidenced by the real owner. AI resemblance judgment is not approval.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 04/05 role;09 costume/hair;20 identity-use authorization
departments.roles_needed: Character/casting decision owner; designer/casting specialist only if unresolved; qualified rights review where relevant.
departments.scope_unit: One master per genuinely distinct identity/state plus representative checks and affected-shot fixes.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Character design/bible and controlled digital continuity within verified permissions; no implied casting or likeness clearance service.
departments.preserve: Preserve intentional transformation, stylization and performance; do not freeze every expression to a master still.

departments.central_question: What geometry, period, spatial logic and material rules control the world?
departments.evidence_boundary: A mood board is not a floor plan. Dream/discontinuous space can be intentional; no plan supplied does not establish no coherent set exists.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: Consecutive inspected views imply incompatible doors/anchors where continuous navigation is necessary; or a supplied design contradicts a stated period/material/use detail on which the scene relies.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: Blocking, camera, light and edit may inherit spatial contradictions; late repairs can spread across shots or build work.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Establish a minimal authoritative space/material rule and relevant anchors. Verify only the consequential historical/detail claim or choose an approved alternate-world rule.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Simple plan/world-rule sheet and discrepancy note linking affected shots, hero interaction assets and explicit exceptions.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Previs/board can traverse the required action under the chosen rule; checked details match their authority or an approved exception. No broad historical-accuracy claim from a few details.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 04/05 action;09 hero props;11 camera/light;20 access/rights where applicable
departments.roles_needed: Design/art-direction owner; location/period/material specialist only for the actual constraint; qualified external physical-build/location roles where needed.
departments.scope_unit: One rule set per distinct environment plus functional interaction assets; reuse across shots.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Digital world design, spatial masters and environment previs; physical build/location operations need separate confirmation.
departments.preserve: Preserve expressive stylization, negative space and useful existing design; no huge bible for one simple image.

departments.central_question: What garments and objects communicate meaning and stay materially consistent?
departments.evidence_boundary: A visual reference does not prove dimensions, fabric composition or licence. Separate exact product truth from expressive wardrobe changes.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: An inspected hero object changes locked construction/label/closure through linked views; or costume/prop design prevents the actual planned action or changes material state without a chosen cause.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: Product/action continuity can fail; performance/VFX may inherit a problem requiring asset replacement rather than a new style prompt.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Lock the functional master/state and replace the failing layer, or change construction/action following a handling test while preserving meaning.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Wardrobe/prop state sheet with source authority, affected interactions and controlled-versus-generated layer split.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Actual fit/handling/motion test supports required action and continuity against approved references. A still alone cannot validate handling.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 06 action;07 identity;08 world;20 product/brand use
departments.roles_needed: Design/continuity owner; actual costume/prop maker or product specialist only where construction/handling is required; qualified safety role for hazardous use.
departments.scope_unit: One master per distinct functional asset/state plus affected continuity repairs; quantities verified before estimate.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Digital product/wardrobe masters and integration. Physical manufacturing/on-set wardrobe are not presumed studio services.
departments.preserve: Preserve meaningful wear/change and coherent existing assets; do not demand precision irrelevant to the film.

departments.central_question: Does each image represent a shot with a function and relation to the next?
departments.evidence_boundary: Boards demonstrate planned relationships, not actual timing; timed review needs actual timed material. One shot and rough drawings can suffice.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: Images labelled a storyboard lack the entry/exit action states needed for a transition; or a supplied timed animatic defeats its own beat through unreadable action or competing attention.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: The editor/animator must invent missing connective material; production may scale an edit that does not yet work.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Assign shot function and necessary cut states, add/combine only needed images, then test the affected timed section with relevant sound/context.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Sequence/shot cards with source identity, action state, composition and transition; a revised animatic section only if actually produced.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Another practitioner reconstructs the intended relation without inventing an event; actual timed review assesses the remaining timing issue and records author choice.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 04/05 intention;06/08 geometry;18 sound;21 relevant framing
departments.roles_needed: Director/editor or storyboard/previs function; artist/animator only where visual construction/motion needs execution.
departments.scope_unit: Affected sequence or representative risky shot plus requested format variants; no compulsory entire-film storyboard.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Storyboard/previs/animatic resolving a supported risk, not a gallery of beautiful independent frames.
departments.preserve: Preserve useful rough boards, successful one-shot design and intentional discontinuity; no coverage grid by default.

departments.central_question: What viewpoint, optics, perspective and motivated light produce this meaning?
departments.evidence_boundary: Do not invent focal length, CCT, exposure, ratios or camera model from an image. A still cannot validate a camera move or focus behavior.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: Adjacent inspected shots accidentally change a required spatial/light relation or hide the subject; or a proposed move/focus event exceeds the geometry/control evidenced by a representative test.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: Meaning/visibility can change unintentionally; a grade cannot repair every perspective/occlusion problem; committing to an unsupported move can multiply rejects.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Choose the necessary viewpoint/light relation and test the critical camera/subject interval; simplify or use controlled geometry if needed, stating expressive tradeoffs.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Shot-specific camera/light diagnosis and path/critical occlusion-focus test plan with observable, not fabricated measured, requirements.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Actual sequence/motion review supports the intended visibility/relation; deliberate exposure/light changes remain allowed. Unmeasured properties remain unmeasured.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 05/06/08 staging;12 look;13/14 route;19 source/color interpretation
departments.roles_needed: Cinematography/virtual-camera lead; actual camera/lighting crew or technical supervisor only for required execution.
departments.scope_unit: A reusable grammar plus specific exceptions and representative hard setups, not equipment suggestions for every shot.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Virtual camera/light development and digital diagnosis. Physical capture/lighting crews require separate verified scope.
departments.preserve: Preserve good existing light/framing and purposeful roughness; no default lens or universal cinematic look.

departments.central_question: Which visual rules define the film across shots?
departments.evidence_boundary: Style authority is domain-specific; it cannot overwrite exact identity/geometry. One mood image does not prove a consistent mastered pipeline.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: References conflict on the same domain and actual frames average them incoherently; or a requested look visibly conceals the story/product relation the work requires.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: Rerolls/polish can retain drift or make the film less readable; finishing may fight a design-level conflict.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Assign palette/material/texture authority and remove conflicting instructions, then alter only the hierarchy that obscures the needed relation.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Look-authority map, representative conditions and targeted styleframe comparison with preserved invariants/allowed variation.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: A representative pair/sequence follows chosen rules while preserving required exact assets; actual size/context review assesses readability, not invented recall.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 03/05 expression;07/09 masters;11 light;19 pipeline
departments.roles_needed: Look/art-direction lead; color/material specialist only where consistent execution needs it.
departments.scope_unit: Representative conditions including the hardest one before scale, not a fixed board count.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Look bible/styleframes/material development and scoped cross-shot application, with human capability/capacity confirmation.
departments.preserve: Preserve intentional mixed media/local shifts and successful look; avoid forced gloss/neon/uniformity.

departments.central_question: What needs persistent and exact 3D spatial truth?
departments.evidence_boundary: CGI serves an actual control need; it is not mandatory. A visual reference is not an editable mesh, and a claimed asset is not an inspected one.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: Required views/motion contradict locked product geometry/topology; or an inspected rig/asset cannot perform the planned deformation/contact.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: Uncontrolled rerolls repeat unstable assets; shot-by-shot compensation for a failing rig can grow and affect comp/edit.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Use/build the simplest controlled geometry/graphics layer that preserves exactness; revise rig/topology or action before multiplying animation.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Reusable asset/rig specification with authority, evidence limits, required views/action and integration pass responsibility.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: A real representative turn/deformation/contact test preserves required geometry and reaches poses without the observed failure; performance needs separate director review. Tolerances require actual requirements/measurement.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 06 performance;08/09 design truth;10/11 action/view;15 integration
departments.roles_needed: CG/technical-art owner; modeler/rigger/animator only for the supported asset/motion need.
departments.scope_unit: One reusable master per distinct asset plus required rig/material states; separate asset work from shot integration.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Controlled CGI assets, virtual camera and render integration where exactness justifies it, not 3D for every frame.
departments.preserve: Preserve usable existing assets and cheaper 2D/practical routes that already meet the need.

departments.central_question: Which variables can be generated and which are locked?
departments.evidence_boundary: Tool marketing, prompt, seed or a successful API call do not prove identity, physics or repeatability in the intended host/workflow.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: Viewed generated motion loses a required identity/contact/action; or the actual attempt log repeats the same structural failure without changing a controlling variable.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: Scaling uncontrolled production propagates rejects; beautiful endpoints may conceal unusable motion and uninformative spending.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Isolate the failing variable, stop uninformative rerolls and test a materially different controlled layer, action design or production route on the hardest interval.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Invariant/reference map, failure interval and a bounded route-comparison test with continue/stop conditions.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Inspect actual motion and adjacent cut against named invariants. Failed PoC rejects a route honestly; endpoint stills or an HTTP result cannot pass production quality.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 07/08/09/12 authority;10/11 shot function;13 exact control;20 source permission
departments.roles_needed: Generative production supervisor/qualified creator; CG/animation/comp specialist only when a failing variable requires it.
departments.scope_unit: Representative risky interval first; inspected shot needs and accepted tests determine scale, with no guaranteed reroll counts.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Supervised generative production with explicit controlled layers/QC; no unlimited reroll service or guarantee from a tool claim.
departments.preserve: Preserve approved footage and non-generative options; do not regenerate usable material without a reason.

departments.central_question: How do altered elements occupy the same physical and optical space?
departments.evidence_boundary: A still may show spatial failure but cannot establish temporal stability. Photorealism is not compulsory for collage/illustration.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: An inspected insert contradicts required occlusion/contact/reflection/perspective; or viewed motion shows matte chatter, unstable edges or changing blur/grain mismatch.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: The composite can remain detached; grading cannot reconstruct absent geometry; still-by-still polish may fail in playback.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Correct the physical/optical relationship or extraction cause, request only necessary plates/passes/control, and test the representative temporal interval before extension.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Comp breakdown linking actual frame interval, holdouts/contact needs, color/alpha interpretation and source ownership, plus before/after motion if executed.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Actual playback at relevant scale and adjacent cuts resolves the named instability/integration failure without destroying intended detail; one corrected still is insufficient.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 11 camera/light;13 renders;14 elements;17 handles/cut;19 pipeline
departments.roles_needed: Compositing/VFX lead; tracking/roto/paint/effects specialists only for the actual shot needs.
departments.scope_unit: One setup per materially different integration condition plus affected intervals; distinguish reusable asset work from shot-specific cleanup.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Tracking, cleanup and controlled integration addressing observed failures; exact feasibility/count require inspection.
departments.preserve: Preserve working plates, useful texture and intentional graphic treatment; no automatic photorealism mandate.

departments.central_question: How do graphic elements move and remain legally/visually exact?
departments.evidence_boundary: Desktop stills do not verify mobile timed readability. Do not invent font licence, brand approval, universal reading duration or current platform safe area.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: Finished text/logo contradicts approved exact copy/geometry; or in viewed timed context movement/contrast/hierarchy prevents a required reading.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: A message/claim can be wrong or functionally unreadable despite technical presence; motion may compete with the principal event.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Replace exact marks/text with controlled graphics; adjust only necessary layout/timing/competition and recompose affected versions without silently changing approved wording.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Copy/graphics master, reading-order motion/layout revision and affected version/language mapping.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Exact copy/mark check against source plus actual timed contextual review at relevant size. Permissions and owner approval remain separate evidence.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 03 message;12 look;17 time;20 claims/marks;21 versions
departments.roles_needed: Graphic/motion designer; copy/localization specialist only for actual language changes; rights owner for permissions.
departments.scope_unit: One reusable graphics system plus genuinely distinct layout/language/timing variants; a simple export is not a new design.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Controlled typography/motion and version-specific recomposition; unverified licences/claims go to their actual owners.
departments.preserve: Preserve purposeful expressive typography and readable minimalism; no compulsory title/end card.

departments.central_question: How do images connect into one film instead of demos?
departments.evidence_boundary: Whole-cut judgment requires timed viewing with known sound limits; paper edit/contact sheets cannot prove actual performance, rhythm or audience response.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: A viewed cut needs action entry/exit states the selected clips lack; or its emphasis/repetition conflicts with its own governing musical/dramatic/formal structure.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: Pretty clips may not join; a flattened experience can survive polish, and generic acceleration may make it worse.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Rebuild from usable cut states, alter sequence/duration or identify precise pickups; compare one bounded alternative against the source/form rather than adding transitions indiscriminately.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Located edit diagnosis, available-source alternatives, paper edit or actual alternative cut, and a minimal pickup/repair list.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Actual rough-cut playback with intended audio/source context supports the chosen relation; author assesses the whole experience. Proposed pickups and retention claims remain unverified.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 04/05 intention;10 relationships;18 audio;19 conform;21 versions
departments.roles_needed: Editor with director/author owner; assistant editor/media supervisor for actual relink/conform complexity.
departments.scope_unit: Affected sequence/master problem plus real cutdowns/recompositions. Inspect editable sources before promising a recut.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Editorial audit/edit construction, cutdowns, precise pickups and scoped digital repair where source access allows.
departments.preserve: Preserve strong cuts, durational form, musical recurrence and useful ellipsis; no automatic fast cutting or voiceover removal.

departments.central_question: What sounds establish cause, perspective, rhythm or brand?
departments.evidence_boundary: Do not claim unheard audio, unavailable lyrics, unseen stems or rights from a public link. Verify exact source context before revising a music video.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: Heard material competes with or contradicts a necessary cue/perspective; or a proposed cut/rewrite conflicts with verified track/version meaning or actual permission limits.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: Meaning/causal perspective can change, or late music replacement can invalidate timing; visual repair may target a sonic problem.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Adjust cue/perspective/arrangement or picture relation, retaining deliberate counterpoint. Resolve the exact source/use conflict instead of manufacturing a compliant-looking replacement story.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Located sound-event map, track/version/source record and affected timing/rights dependency; bounded comparison proposal.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Listen to actual revised material in context; actual source/rights owner resolves required meaning/use questions. An AI suggestion or public availability is not clearance.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 04/05 source meaning;17 timing;20 permissions;21 actual audio/access/language versions
departments.roles_needed: Sound/editorial owner with author; sound designer/mixer/composer/voice performer/music supervisor only for required and confirmed work.
departments.scope_unit: A defined audio/mix task per master plus genuinely distinct commissioned stems/language/access versions; no assumed music commission.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Audio-visual edit/sound integration only within verified studio/team scope; composition, casting and licensing require separate confirmation.
departments.preserve: Preserve silence, voiceover, lyrics, faith/source relationships and musical recurrence; no generic ban on explanation.

departments.central_question: Does light/color/material remain coherent across versions?
departments.evidence_boundary: Separate look, source interpretation, display and encoding. Screenshot values do not establish original pipeline, and a playable master does not prove a correct conform.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: Adjacent inspected shots shift unchosen product/skin/material relations; or an actual finish export differs from the approved cut in source/frame/crop/sync.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: The sequence may not cohere; a global LUT can preserve mismatch, while a technically valid master can be the wrong film.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Verify interpretation before balancing; conform against the actual approved reference before optional creative polish, preserving intentional changes.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Sequence grade plan and located conform discrepancy log with source/timeline/master identifiers and before/after comparisons if executed.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Actual sequence review through stated pipeline/display context and frame/order/crop/sync comparison closes the identified issue. Unchecked viewing conditions remain explicit.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 11 source/light;12 look;15 comp;17 approved edit;21 master spec;22 custody
departments.roles_needed: Color/finishing owner; colorist or online/conform specialist only for actual pipeline requirements.
departments.scope_unit: Sequence grade/conform per distinct master plus required variant transforms/QC; separate signal correction from new content production.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Non-generative grading, conform/finishing and scoped QC within verified tools/team; no universal cinematic transformation promise.
departments.preserve: Preserve approved texture, rawness and source pixels; no unsolicited regeneration or destructive normalization.

departments.central_question: What material is legal, accurate and approved for this use?
departments.evidence_boundary: No document uploaded does not mean unlicensed; do not declare legality, clearance or illegality from a reference or noncommercial label. A full script cannot prove external rights absence.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: A specific inspected product assertion contradicts its approved source or lacks substantiation in the supplied evidence; or provided permission explicitly excludes the contemplated use.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: Dependent execution may fail actual brand/legal review or need late asset/message replacement.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Locate the exact claim/use mismatch, seek verified wording/permission through the authorized owner, or design an approved alternative. Block only the affected use, without unauthorized private transfer.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Asset/use/permission and claim register: exact wording/asset, source, scope, known limit, owner, affected work and alternative.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Actual required human/qualified review confirms wording/use or replacement. Model reasoning does not substantiate a claim, sign a declaration or grant permission.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 01 intended use;07 identity;09 product;16 copy/marks;18 music;21 territories/versions
departments.roles_needed: Rights/claim decision owner; qualified legal/clearance professional for legal judgment; brand/source owner for approvals.
departments.scope_unit: One materially different asset/use/claim entry, grouping valid shared permissions; no invented legal checklist for every sketch.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Prepare a clean provenance handoff and adjust execution to verified boundaries; no implied objekts legal service or clearance.
departments.preserve: Preserve valid permissions and truthful approved work; do not invent legal blockers to enlarge a sale.

departments.central_question: What are the actual media deliverables and acceptance checks?
departments.evidence_boundary: Current limits/safe zones/specifications require the actual official/customer source. Do not invent universal accessibility/legal duties; captions alone are not accessibility proof.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: A viewed requested version crops or retimes essential action/text; or actual delivered media/caption/transfer fails an identified recipient requirement.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: Dimensions can pass while meaning fails; the recipient may be unable to publish, understand or continue the project.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Classify derivative/recomposed/new production work, fix only the affected framing/action/layout, and verify the real recipient workflow; separate exports from project restore.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Per-version deliverable matrix with spec sources, meaningful differences, reusable assets and file-specific QC/receipt if actually checked.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Every requested file gets relevant decode/playback/text/sync/context checks. Required project relink/restore and actual recipient acceptance need their own observed evidence.

departments.upstream_dependencies: 16 graphics/language;17 approved version;18 audio/access;19 masters;20 use limits;22 recipient/custody
departments.roles_needed: Delivery/QC owner; localization/accessibility specialist or media engineer only for actual commissioned requirements.
departments.scope_unit: Each materially distinct requested deliverable and relevant checks; a simple verified export is not a new concept.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: Version recomposition/digital adaptation and delivery/QC within confirmed scope; publishing and recipient acceptance need actual receipts.
departments.preserve: Preserve sufficient single-master delivery and usable exports; no automatic all-ratios/all-languages package.

departments.central_question: Who approves what and which test reduces risk earliest?
departments.evidence_boundary: A plan is not a booking, real estimate or capacity confirmation. No invented purchase, safety sign-off, staff availability, source receipt or production percentage.

conditional_diagnostic.evidence_trigger: The supplied plan commits costly work before a dependency that could invalidate it; or its actual version/custody trail cannot identify an approved cut/source, or restore/relink fails.
conditional_diagnostic.cost_of_error: Rework/deadline risk can grow despite activity; the team can finish the wrong version or lose recoverable source work.
conditional_diagnostic.professional_decision: Resolve the critical dependency with the smallest decisive test; parallelize genuinely independent tasks. Establish one actual approved reference and custody/version responsibility before irreversible cleanup.
conditional_diagnostic.artifact: Dependency/decision roadmap and named work packages: actual affected shots/assets/versions, prerequisites, responsible function, acceptance and unresolved counts; source/approval/restore register.
conditional_diagnostic.acceptance: Actual test/approval unlocks dependencies. A receiver can locate required sources/current approval; transfer/relink/restore results and human capacity/estimates are recorded only when performed/confirmed.

departments.upstream_dependencies: Only affected functions;20 necessary permissions/specialist safety;21 recipient criteria
departments.roles_needed: Producer/project owner, possibly the creator. Coordinator/media supervisor only as scale requires; qualified external scene-specific live-action/safety roles; real studio representative for quotes/capacity.
departments.scope_unit: Finding-derived work packages with known units and conditional extensions; unknown counts/rates/timing remain unknown until inspected/human-confirmed.
departments.objekts_value_if_verified: An honest scoped digital-production opportunity and handoff preview, contingent on verified studio capability/capacity. No automatic lead send, purchase or guaranteed acceptance.
departments.preserve: Preserve the existing team, DIY route, valid approvals and reusable work; no mandatory 22-person organization.

cross_cutting_responsibilities.limit: Scene-specific qualified humans; no remote safety certification or presumed objekts physical production.
Geometry/generation competence does not establish animated performance competence; assign a lead when needed.
Playable export does not prove custody, relink or restore; test the actual requested workflow.
Confirm actual commission/current official requirements; subtitles alone do not prove accessibility.
